releases.name: Lanky Looters
releases.summary: The TwiHard Quiz - For Twilight Fans - FREEDo you know who reprises the role of Edward Cullen in Twilight, Breaking Dawn? Or the names of author Stephanie Meyer’s three children?Then this free Twilight trivia quiz might be the app for you.With plenty of multiple choice questions, this fast-paced quiz is a fun way to test who is most savvy about the Twilight films and books. The questions range from knowing what Jane can do with her mind to being familiar of the name of the organized coven of vampires that reside in Volterra in Italy.Made by a group of the Twilight enthusiasts, this quiz is packed with questions about the novels and films.  The app features integration with Facebook which makes it easy to compete against your friends and family - and brag about your wins! Also, it includes a rating system that makes is possible to measure exactly how well you stack up against the competition.It’s fun, it’s social. And most importantly: It’s free!What are you waiting for? Download the app and start quizzing :)

releases.name: Bigfoot Hunting
releases.summary:
Step into the heart of the untamed wilderness in Bigfoot Hunting, a high-stakes survival experience designed for thrill-seekers. Armed with only your instincts, a trusty weapon, and limited supplies, you’ll face off against one of the greatest legends of the forest—Bigfoot.

Track, hunt, and survive in a living, breathing ecosystem where every shadow could be your last. The hunt is on… but remember, you’re not the only one watching.
